items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: As a matter of fact, Morton Gould was the one that asked me to come up as his guest one night up at the Top of the Theatre and when I went I took the band and played.

ctx.x: As a matter of fact, Morton Gould was the one that asked me to come up as his guest one night up at the Top of the Theatre and when I went I took the band and played.
